note: ported samples whose control is out of scope (deprecated; a control newer than UI5 1.71 is in scope since 2026-10-20 and needs no entry - its port declares POST_171 instead) but which are ALLOWED to stay - each with the reason. The out-of-scope check in generate-coverage.mjs FAILS (exit 1) on any ported out-of-scope sample NOT listed here, so new violations can never land silently; listed ones print an informational note. Entries are a maintainer decision - do not add one just to silence the gate. Each entry PINS the scope facts the decision was made on ('decided': scope verdict, control @since, deprecation @since) - when a metadata refresh changes any of them the gate FAILS so a maintainer re-decides (and re-pins) instead of the entry silently outliving its rationale.
